summary.en: Takeda combines immunology, neuroscience and oncology programs with plasma-derived therapies. Licensing and co-development contribute several major late-stage assets.
summary.zh: Takeda 的研发覆盖免疫、神经科学、肿瘤及血浆蛋白治疗，多个后期重点项目来自许可引进或联合开发。

ind.zh: 原发性免疫缺陷病（美国申报）；另开发慢性炎性脱髓鞘性多发性神经根神经病

ind.zh: α1 抗胰蛋白酶缺乏相关肝病
免疫性血小板减少症；另开发 IgA 肾病

target.zh: Activin A/B 配体捕获蛋白

ind.zh: 骨髓增生异常综合征相关贫血；另开发骨髓纤维化相关贫血

target.zh: PD-1 / IL-2 α 偏向性融合蛋白

next.zh: 计划于 Takeda 2027 财年在日本申报

watch.en: Zasocitinib is under FDA priority review and EU review.
watch.zh: Zasocitinib 正接受 FDA 优先审评及欧盟审评。

watch.en: Elritercept and the two Innovent oncology programs carry external licensing or collaboration economics.
watch.zh: Elritercept 及两个 Innovent 肿瘤项目涉及外部许可或合作分成。

watch.en: Oveporexton and rusfertide obtained U.S. approvals in August 2026; launch execution now matters.
watch.zh: Oveporexton 与 rusfertide 于 2026 年 8 月在美国获批，后续需关注商业化执行。

watch.en: FY2026 guidance still anticipates a low-single-digit core revenue decline at constant exchange rates.
watch.zh: 2026 财年指引仍预计按固定汇率计算的核心收入出现低个位数下降。

gaps: No complete company-reported phase-count series was verified; counts is null rather than a manual tally.
Origin was not verified for TAK-881, mezagitamab and TAK-360; these origins are null. TAK-360 has no separate verified generic name or alternative code.

Next milestones/dates were not reliably verified for most selected assets; next is null. Arcotatug's Japan filing is explicitly FY2027 (April 2027–March 2028), so next.when is null to avoid mislabeling it as calendar 2027.

Already approved uses, regional-only filings of approved indications (including rusfertide in the EU), and unexercised option assets were excluded. TAK-881 is a new investigational formulation; vedolizumab's filed pediatric expansion was not selected within the eight-asset shortlist.
The FY2025 SEC filing predates 2026-06 and is used only for the historical Nimbus/zasocitinib acquisition, not current development status.
Protein replacement and ligand-trap modalities are mapped to other because the allowed vocabulary has no recombinant/plasma protein category.
